access.signedOutBody: Sign in with a reviewer role. No queue data or decision controls are shown.

degraded.title: The approval queue could not be read
degraded.body: Nothing is shown as empty. The queue is unavailable, which is not the same as having no requests.
degraded.detail: We could not read the items in this request. We do not claim the result is empty. Package actions stay off.

empty.title: No requests waiting for your decision
empty.body: Maker-checker excludes your own requests. Nothing else is open in your area.
empty.stepTitle: Nothing of this kind in the package
empty.stepBody: The read succeeded and returned none. This request changes no object of this kind.

rail.heading: Requests
rail.emptyBody: Nothing is waiting for your decision with this filter.

overview.absent: Priority and impact level are not stored against a request, so they are not shown. A request creates or amends configuration; there is no delete.

object.noDependencies: No parent object in this package.
object.dependentsNote: Counts what the library already holds under this record. Downstream reach — packages, factories, report types — is not computed anywhere, so none is claimed.
object.dependentsUnavailable: The recorded dependents could not be read.

diff.caption: Recorded values against the values this request proposes.

decision.commentHint: Recorded against the decision and shown in the timeline.
decision.rejectHint: A comment is required to reject.
decision.cascade: Rejecting this also auto-rejects {count} dependent object(s). The database applies that immediately and does not ask again.
decision.returnNote: Return applies to the whole package, not one item. The database accepts only approve or reject for a single item.

summary.heading: Package decision summary
summary.settled: Every object carries a terminal decision
summary.outstanding: Some items are still waiting for a decision
summary.missingComment: Rejected or returned without a comment
summary.missingCommentNote: The database requires a comment when you reject or return. So this should stay at zero. A number above zero means the record is older than that rule.

package.heading: Package decision
package.readOnly: Read only. Your role can view this request but cannot decide or publish it.
package.gate: You cannot publish until every item has a final decision. The database checks again before publishing.
package.reasonHint: Required. Recorded against the decision and shown in the timeline.

timeline.heading: Timeline
timeline.emptyBody: The read succeeded and returned no revisions, decisions or publications.
